lines.en: label bathhouse10:
scene bathhouseten1
I head over to the bathhouse to find Io and Yuki hanging out at the counter.
lines.zh: 我走到澡堂，发现 Io 和 Yuki 正在柜台那边待着。

lines.en: And, judging by Yuki’s skin being significantly less pale and lifeless than usual, I think it’s safe to assume that she is on her way out.
lines.zh: 而且从 Yuki 的皮肤明显不像平时那样苍白、毫无生气来看，我觉得可以肯定她正在好转。

lines.en: I apologize to Yuki inside of my head for making fun of her skin. I wish her the best in her journey back to health.
lines.zh: 我在心里向 Yuki 道歉，不该拿她的皮肤开玩笑。祝她早日康复。

lines.en: : Yo. Five minutes earlier and you would have gotten to see me nude.
lines.zh: : 哟。早来五分钟你就能看到我光着的样子了。

lines.en: : Damn it. I knew I should have run here.
lines.zh: : 该死。我就知道该跑着来。

lines.en: : Hey, Sensei. Welcome back.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei。欢迎回来。

lines.en: : Yuki was just leaving.
lines.zh: : Yuki 正要走。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten2
: Was I? Cause I’m pretty sure I was planning on making fun of you for losing to my daughter a little more.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我明明记得我还打算再多嘲笑你几句输给我女儿的事。

lines.en: : Nope! You were just leaving. Bye, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 不！你正要走呢。拜拜，Yuki。

lines.en: : I take it this means you told her about the dorm war results?
lines.zh: : 看来你跟她说了宿舍大战的结果？

lines.en: scene bathhouseten3
: See? Told you Yumi was going to win if all that had to be done was cooperate or whatever.
lines.zh: : 看吧？我早说了，只要需要做的事不过是合作什么的，Yumi 就会赢。

lines.en: : Io’s less of a brat, but she’ll never cooperate with anyone or anything. Just the kind of girl she is.
lines.zh: : Io 没那么讨人厌，可她永远不会跟任何人、任何事合作。她就是那种人。

lines.en: : Yes. I am a pitiful isolationist. Why are we still talking about this?
lines.zh: : 是的。我是个可悲的孤立主义者。我们为什么还在聊这个？

lines.en: : Cause I’ve gotta brag to your fuckin’ teacher on my way out.
lines.zh: : 因为我得在走之前跟你这个操蛋老师炫耀一下。

lines.en: : What will that accomplish, though? It's already over and done with.
lines.zh: : 可那能有什么用？都已经结束了。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten4
: It won’t {i}accomplish{/i} shit. It’s just fun.
lines.zh: : 什么用也没有。就是好玩。

lines.en: : This is the last time I let you use my shampoo.
lines.zh: : 这是我最后一次让你用我的洗发水。

lines.en: : Your bill is six million yen. Please leave the money on the counter and be on your way.
lines.zh: : 你的账单是六百万日元。请把钱放在柜台上，然后走人。

lines.en: : Nah, hold on a sec. Just cause I want to brag about how I was right doesn’t mean there’s no lesson on the way for you.
lines.zh: : 不，等等。我想炫耀自己猜对了，不代表你就没有一课要上。

lines.en: : Can we maybe leave the lessons to my teacher?
lines.zh: : 能不能把上课这活儿留给我的老师？

lines.en: : No. Go ahead, Yuki. I don’t particularly enjoy teaching anyway.
lines.zh: : 不行。说吧，Yuki。反正我也不怎么喜欢教书。

lines.en: : Then change your fucking career, dude.
lines.zh: : 那就他妈换个职业啊，哥们。

lines.en: : Ugh...what’s the “lesson” I have to learn today, Yuki? Just get it over with.
lines.zh: : 唉……今天我要学的「一课」是什么，Yuki？赶紧说完吧。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten5
: The lesson is that you’re completely fucked if you’re not even going to try and win winnable battles.
lines.zh: : 这一课就是：如果连能赢的仗都不肯去赢，你就彻底完蛋了。

lines.en: : The hell is wrong with cooperating? What happened to all that shit about you being fake as hell or whatever it is you’re always saying?
lines.zh: : 合作有什么问题？你老是说自己假得要死什么的，那些话都去哪儿了？

lines.en: : Wouldn't being fake mean sticking your neck out for your team even though you don’t want to?
lines.zh: : 假，不就是明明不想、还是为自己团队出头吗？

lines.en: : You’re forgetting the very important detail of me also being a hypocrite.
lines.zh: : 你忘了很重要的一点——我也是个伪君子。

lines.en: : So yes, I am incredibly fake in many respects. But I am fake on my own terms. Which means not getting involved with a bunch of sentient handbags.
lines.zh: : 所以没错，我在很多方面假得离谱。但我是按自己的方式假。也就是说，不跟一堆有意识的手提包搅在一起。

lines.en: : Yumi might be a brat, but she ain’t a fuckin’ handbag.
lines.zh: : Yumi 可能是个讨厌鬼，但她不是他妈的手提包。

lines.en: : Yumi was on the other team. And she like, won by default or something. So it’s not like it was even a deserved win.
lines.zh: : Yumi 在对面那队。而且她算是，不战而胜什么的。所以那场胜利也不算实至名归。

lines.en: : Also, why are we still talking about this?
lines.zh: : 还有，我们为什么还在聊这个？

lines.en: : Just fuckin’ shape up, kid. Ya ain’t gonna be happy if you’re so dead set on never doing anything for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 就他妈振作点，小鬼。你要是打定主意这辈子什么都不做，是不会幸福的。

lines.en: : Then I guess I’m never going to be happy. Thanks, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 那我想我这辈子都不会幸福了。谢了，Yuki。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten6
: Man, do you really deal with this shit every day?
lines.zh: : 天啊，你真每天都应付这些破事？

lines.en: : Not really. In true Io fashion, she doesn’t really talk while she’s in[school].
lines.zh: : 也不算。按 Io 的风格，她在[school]里基本不说话。

lines.en: : Beat. Just means she’s missin’ out on forging new friendships and all that.
lines.zh: : 挺好。只是说明她错过了结交新朋友之类的。

lines.en: : Yes. At this rate, Io will never have any bond as strong as the one between you and me, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 是啊。照这个速度，Io 永远也不会有像你和我之间这样牢固的羁绊，Yuki。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten7
: I have Uta!
lines.zh: : 我有 Uta！

lines.en: : And besides, you two aren’t even that close!
lines.zh: : 再说了，你们俩也没那么亲密！

lines.en: : Sure we are. Your teacher and I chill all the time now. He practically has me on speed dial.
lines.zh: : 我们当然亲密。你老师和我现在整天混在一起。他差不多把我设成快捷拨号了。

lines.en: : Speed dial isn’t even a thing anymore! Probably.
lines.zh: : 快捷拨号这东西早就不存在了！大概吧。

lines.en: : If it is, I have no idea how to use it.
lines.zh: : 就算存在，我也不知道怎么用。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten8
: But that doesn’t matter!
lines.zh: : 不过那不重要！

lines.en: : You two can get as close as you want. I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 你们俩想多亲近就多亲近。我不在乎。

lines.en: : But rubbing it in my face isn’t going to make me think, “Oh. Time to turn things around and be a normal member of society.”
lines.zh: : 可在我面前显摆，并不会让我觉得「哦，是时候改头换面、当个正常的社会人了」。

lines.en: : We can get as close as we want?
lines.zh: : 我们想多亲近就多亲近？

lines.en: : I mean, I’d prefer that you didn’t because it would make things extremely awkward for me and I really don’t want to clean up whatever mess you would leave behind in the men’s bath-
lines.zh: : 我是说，我更希望你们别，因为那会让我极其尴尬，而且我真不想收拾你会在男汤里留下的烂摊子——

lines.en: scene bathhouseten9
: Uhh...okay. No need to get graphic. I obviously wasn’t being serious.
lines.zh: : 呃……好了。不用说得这么具体。我显然不是认真的。

lines.en: Damn it.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: : But still...I don’t care. Do whatever.
lines.zh: : 不过还是……我不在乎。随便你们。

lines.en: : Also, the whole thing with the speed dial wasn’t even fair since Sensei doesn’t have my phone number yet.
lines.zh: : 另外，快捷拨号那事本来就不公平，因为 Sensei 还没有我的电话号码。

lines.en: : You know there’s a very easy way to change that, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道有个很简单的方法能改变这一点，对吧？

lines.en: scene bathhouseten10
: You really askin’ a [teenage]girl for her number right in front of me?
lines.zh: : 你真当着我的面向一个[teenage]女孩要号码？

lines.en: : Yes, because you and I have an unbreakable bond and you will not judge me for it.
lines.zh: : 是的，因为你和我有牢不可破的羁绊，你不会因此评判我。

lines.en: : That was just...yeah, aight. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 这……行吧，随便你。

lines.en: : I’d be more than happy to give you my contact information. I was just under the impression you didn’t want me to have {i}yours{/i} since I would annoy you all the time.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意把联系方式给你。我只是以为你不想让我有「{i}你的{/i}」，因为我一天到晚会烦你。

lines.en: : You already annoy me all the time. A little more won’t hurt.
lines.zh: : 你已经一天到晚烦我了。再多一点也不碍事。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten11
: Really?!
lines.zh: : 真的？！

lines.en: : Oh, wow. You're really that excited about this?
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。这事你真这么激动？

lines.en: : I am! Because now I can shove it in Yuki’s stupid face and start my own inseparable bond with you!
lines.zh: : 激动！因为现在我可以在 Yuki 那张蠢脸前显摆，然后开始和你建立属于我们自己的形影不离的羁绊！

lines.en: : The fuck just happened? We were teasing her like two seconds ago and now you guys are legit flirting.
lines.zh: : 刚才到底发生了什么？两秒钟前我们还在逗她，现在你们就真的在调情了。

lines.en: : It’s not flirting. Io just really likes me for some reason.
lines.zh: : 这不是调情。Io 只是不知道为什么特别喜欢我。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten12
: Yeah...weird.
lines.zh: : 是啊……真怪。

lines.en: : You ain’t hiding a dragon tattoo anywhere on your body, are you? Only time I’ve seen her get that excited is when she got to touch mine.
lines.zh: : 你身上没藏着龙的纹身什么的吧？我唯一一次见她这么激动，是她能摸我的时候。

lines.en: : No, but...I’ve also never looked at my back, so...
lines.zh: : 没有，不过……我也从没看过自己的背，所以……

lines.en: scene bathhouseten13
: Want me to check for you?
lines.zh: : 要我帮你看看吗？

lines.en: : My hands are cold and callused and I can’t imagine they’ll feel very good if I touch you but, so long as you don’t turn around, it should be fine.
lines.zh: : 我的手又冷又粗糙，摸上去大概不会太舒服，不过只要你不转过身来，应该没事。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with turning around when you’ve seen my penis before?
lines.zh: : 你都看过我的阴茎了，转过身来有什么问题？

lines.en: scene bathhouseten14
: Okay, that’s enough for me.
lines.zh: : 好，我受够了。

lines.en: : Enjoy your new unbreakable bond or whatever. I’m gonna go load up on ramen and probably pass out on my bike.
lines.zh: : 享受你们那牢不可破的新羁绊什么的吧。我要去狂吃拉面，然后大概会趴在我的自行车上睡着。

lines.en: : Night, Yuki. Thanks for inadvertently becoming the bridge Sensei and I needed to exchange contact information.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Yuki。谢谢你无意间成了我和 Sensei 交换联系方式所需要的桥梁。

lines.en: : Kids are fuckin’ weird now.
lines.zh: : 现在的孩子真他妈奇怪。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten15
Yuki leaves the store and I get a little closer to the counter.
lines.zh: Yuki 离开店里，我往柜台靠近了一点。

lines.en: : So, about my penis.
lines.zh: : 那么，关于我的阴茎。

lines.en: : Weird segue.
lines.zh: : 这转折真怪。

lines.en: : Does this bathhouse provide any sort of “extra services?” Because that's what you made it sound like just now.
lines.zh: : 这澡堂提供什么「额外服务」吗？因为你刚才说得像是有的。

lines.en: : Nope. But I’m sure one of the imaginary old ladies playing mahjong in the back room that we don’t have would be happy to help you out for the right price.
lines.zh: : 不提供。不过我相信后屋那些我们根本没有的、虚构的打麻将的老太太，会乐意以合适的价钱帮你。

lines.en: : So that thing about your hands being cold and callused or whatever-
lines.zh: : 那你说你的手又冷又粗糙什么的——

lines.en: : Grave misinterpretation. I was just talking about washing your back.
lines.zh: : 天大的误解。我只是说给你搓背。

lines.en: : Well, it would certainly make sense why I’m not supposed to turn around then.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那确实能解释为什么我不该转过身来。

lines.en: : Right.
: Anyway, can I give you my number now?
lines.zh: : 总之，我现在能给你我的号码了吗？

lines.en: : Oh, cool. We got over that misunderstanding a lot quicker than I thought we would.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。这个误会比我想的解开得快多了。

lines.en: : It comes with the job. Gotta be ready for stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 干这行的必备技能。得随时准备好应对这种事。

lines.en: : Number?
lines.zh: : 号码？

lines.en: : Sure.
scene black
I slide my phone across the counter to Io, who programs her number into it and sends herself a quick text message to-
lines.zh: 我把手机滑过柜台递给 Io，她把自己的号码输进去，然后给自己发了条短信，好——

lines.en: : Wait, why did you send a heart?
lines.zh: : 等等，你为什么发了一颗心？

lines.en: : First emoji I saw. Definitely not going to look at it all the time and tell myself that you like me or anything.
lines.zh: : 我看到的第一个表情。我绝对不会一直盯着它看、然后告诉自己你喜欢我什么的。

lines.en: : That’s a strangely specific and unwarranted thing to clarify.
lines.zh: : 这澄清得莫名其妙又没来由。

lines.en: : Yes. Yes it is.
lines.zh: : 是。确实是。

lines.en: : Now! Right this way, sir! I will show you to your bath!
lines.zh: : 好了！这边请，先生！我带您去您的浴池！

lines.en: $ ionumber = True
{i}Congratulations! You now have Io’s cell phone number!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你现在有 Io 的手机号码了！{/i}

lines.en: Io quickly pushes me through the curtain and into the men’s locker room, completely disregarding her responsibilities as an employee of this establishment.
lines.zh: Io 迅速把我推进帘子、推进男更衣室，完全无视了她作为本店员工的职责。

lines.en: I’m going to have to file a complaint.
lines.zh: 我得去投诉。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten16
: This is strange behavior for someone who refused {i}additional{/i} service to me just seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 对一个几秒钟前还拒绝给我「{i}额外{/i}」服务的人来说，这行为挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : Feel free to undress whenever you’d like.
lines.zh: : 您随时可以脱衣服。

lines.en: : Are you actually going to wash my back?
lines.zh: : 你真要给我搓背？

lines.en: : Nah. We don’t do that here either.
lines.zh: : 不。我们这儿也不干那个。

lines.en: : But you {i}do{/i} escort customers to the locker room and watch them get undressed.
lines.zh: : 可你{i}确实{/i}会把客人领到更衣室、看着他们脱衣服。

lines.en: : Only one customer has received this “escort” you speak of, and I wasn’t planning on watching you.
lines.zh: : 得到这种「引领」的客人只有一位，而且我也没打算看你。

lines.en: : I was just gonna close my eyes and talk to you while you relaxed or something.
lines.zh: : 我本来打算闭上眼睛，你放松的时候跟你说说话什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. It seemed less weird in the lobby where the TV was on and everything wasn’t completely silent.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。在前厅有电视开着、一切都不那么安静的时候，这听起来没那么怪。

lines.en: : Should I leave?
lines.zh: : 我该走吗？

lines.en: : I should leave.
lines.zh: : 我该走。

lines.en: : I’m gonna leave.
lines.zh: : 我要走了。

lines.en: : You don’t have to leave.
lines.zh: : 你不必走。

lines.en: : Just think of it as...payback for you getting undressed in my hotel room or something.
lines.zh: : 就当是……你在我的酒店房间里脱衣服的某种报应吧。

lines.en: : Except I was in wholesome onesie pajamas afterward and you’re going to be...not wearing those.
lines.zh: : 可我之后穿的是健康的连体睡衣，而你会……不穿那玩意儿。

lines.en: : It would be an extremely funny surprise if I was, though.
lines.zh: : 不过要是我穿了，那会是个特别好笑的惊喜。

lines.en: : No, it would be gross and weird. Save the cute pajamas for me.
lines.zh: : 不，那只会又恶心又怪。可爱的睡衣留给我。

lines.en: : Io, please explain to me what’s happening right now.
lines.zh: : Io，给我解释一下现在到底在发生什么。

lines.en: : The bad parts of me are waging war with good parts of me. Which are waging war with my hormones. Which are, in turn, waging war with my greatest fears.
lines.zh: : 我坏的一面在和好的一面交战。好的一面又在和我的荷尔蒙交战。而荷尔蒙又在和我最大的恐惧交战。

lines.en: : Basically, I’m being Io again. Yay.
lines.zh: : 基本上，我又在当 Io 了。耶。

lines.en: : I don’t know. This is weird.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。这很怪。

lines.en: : Am I taking a bath or am I not taking a bath?
lines.zh: : 我到底洗不洗澡？

lines.en: : I...guess that depends on if you want to take a bath?
lines.zh: : 我……想那得看你想不想洗？

lines.en: : I mean, that wasn’t the intention when I came here...
lines.zh: : 我是说，我来这儿的时候没打算……

lines.en: : Am I forcing you into doing something you aren’t comfortable with?
lines.zh: : 我是在逼你做你不舒服的事吗？

lines.en: : Are you forcing {i}yourself{/i} into doing something you aren’t comfortable with?
lines.zh: : 你是在逼「你{i}自己{/i}」做你不舒服的事吗？

lines.en: : I’m just trying to spend time with you in a way that won’t tire you out.
lines.zh: : 我只是想用一种不会让你累的方式跟你待一会儿。

lines.en: : I’m exhausting, right?
lines.zh: : 我很累人，对吧？

lines.en: : And I figure that if you’re warm and cozy and wet and stuff, you’ll be a little less annoyed by all of the talking I’m going to do.
lines.zh: : 而且我想，如果你又暖和、又舒服、又湿漉漉什么的，接下来我要说的那么多话就不至于让你太烦。

lines.en: : And you’re not just saying that to compensate for something you’re realizing now is flat out odd?
lines.zh: : 你说这些，不是在为一件你现在才意识到很古怪的事找补？

lines.en: scene bathhouseten17
: So it’s odd because it’s me.
lines.zh: : 所以是因为是我，才显得古怪。

lines.en: : It’s odd in general.
lines.zh: : 这事本身就古怪。

lines.en: : But it wasn’t odd when you came here with that blonde girl.
lines.zh: : 可你和那个金发女孩来的时候就不古怪。

lines.en: : Okay, valid point.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这点你说得对。

lines.en: : I mean...it’s not like I’m going to be {i}in there{/i} with you, you know? I’ll be turned around, talking about...stuff.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我又不会「{i}进去{/i}」跟你一起，你知道吧？我会背过身去，聊……各种东西。

lines.en: : Which, in theory, we could have just done in the lobby.
lines.zh: : 理论上，这我们在前厅就能做。

lines.en: : But I already said all that stuff about you being relaxed and warm. So isn’t that like, a preexisting counterpoint?
lines.zh: : 可我都说了你会放松、会暖和那些话。那不就是一个现成的反驳点吗？

lines.en: : It sounds like more of an unplanned rationalization to me.
lines.zh: : 我听着更像是临时找的合理化借口。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten18
: Then it fits me perfectly!
lines.zh: : 那正合我意！

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: scene bathhouseten19
: The fact that you’re still talking makes this a million times worse than it would be if you just...did what you wanted rather than wait for me to do something.
lines.zh: : 你还在说话这件事，让这一切比你就……做你想做的事、而不是等着我做点什么，要糟糕一百万倍。

lines.en: She’s right.
lines.zh: 她是对的。

lines.en: That’s what I’m {i}supposed{/i} to do after all.
lines.zh: 毕竟那才是我「{i}该{/i}」做的。

lines.en: Why bother trying to fix situations that I did not personally break?
lines.zh: 何必去修补那些又不是我亲手弄坏的局面？

lines.en: I’m here at a bathhouse. Which means I should take a bath.
lines.zh: 我在一家澡堂。也就是说我该泡个澡。

lines.en: And if anyone is there to awkwardly try and hold a conversation with me as it happens, that’s on them.
lines.zh: 而如果有人在那儿笨拙地想边泡边跟我聊天，那是他们的事。

lines.en: : You’re weird.
lines.zh: : 你真怪。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten20
: Yeah...
: Yeah, this was a bad idea.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这是个坏主意。

lines.en: : Nah. Just close your eyes.
lines.zh: : 不坏。闭上眼睛就好。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten21
scene black
Io does as she’s told and closes her eyes.
lines.zh: Io 照做了，闭上了眼睛。

lines.en: I take a moment to awkwardly remove my clothes several feet away from a cute [teenager], something I’ve done hundreds (If not thousands) of times in the past.
lines.zh: 我花了一点时间，在离一个可爱的[teenager]几英尺远的地方笨拙地脱掉衣服——这种事我过去做过几百次（如果不是几千次）。

lines.en: But something feels different about this time in particular.
lines.zh: 但这一次感觉有些不同。

lines.en: Like it’s something that neither of us particularly {i}wants{/i} to do, but something we’re doing nonetheless.
lines.zh: 像是那种我们俩都不太「{i}想{/i}」做、却还是在做的事。

lines.en: I don’t even have an erection.
lines.zh: 我连勃起都没有。

lines.en: It’s just a bath.
lines.zh: 只是泡个澡。

lines.en: That’s all it is.
lines.zh: 就是这样。

lines.en: I get into the water and let my body soak in both chemicals and uncertainty.
lines.zh: 我下到水里，让身体浸在化学物质和不确定之中。

lines.en: And I hear a stool dragged across the stone floor just moments later.
lines.zh: 片刻之后，我听见一张凳子被拖过石地板。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten22
: Is it hot enough?
lines.zh: : 水够热吗？

lines.en: : It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 挺好的。

lines.en: : Okay...
: So, uhh...Yuki.
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……Yuki。

lines.en: : Is that going to be our conversation topic for the night?
lines.zh: : 这就是我们今晚的话题了？

lines.en: : It’s just the first thing that came to mind.
lines.zh: : 只是第一个想到的。

lines.en: : Well, the first thing actually worth talking about that came to mind.
lines.zh: : 我是说，第一个想到的、真正值得一谈的事。

lines.en: : There were a lot of other things that popped into my head beforehand, but they were all either stupid or pointless.
lines.zh: : 在那之前我脑子里冒出过很多别的，但要么蠢，要么没意义。

lines.en: : So...Yuki, then.
lines.zh: : 那么……就 Yuki 吧。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten23
: Her and Yumi...
lines.zh: : 她和 Yumi……

lines.en: : Could you...tell me a little about them?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……跟我说说她们？

lines.en: : Why not ask her?
lines.zh: : 为什么不直接问她？

lines.en: : I’ve tried. But she always gets this look on her face that’s like a mix of...regretful and defeated.
lines.zh: : 我问过。可她每次脸上都会露出那种……混合着后悔和认命的表情。

lines.en: : And I don’t want to make her talk about things that will obviously upset her.
lines.zh: : 我不想逼她说那些明显会让她难过的事。

lines.en: : And...given Yumi’s general demeanor, I’m starting to think that maybe Yuki wasn’t really as great back then as she is now.
lines.zh: : 而且……从 Yumi 的一贯态度来看，我开始觉得，也许 Yuki 当年并不像现在这么好。

lines.en: : She’s had her fair share of problems. They all make sense given the situation she was brought up in, though.
lines.zh: : 她有过不少问题。不过考虑到她成长的处境，这些都说得通。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : And...do you think that situation justifies anything that she may have done?
lines.zh: : 那么……你觉得那种处境，能为她可能做过的事开脱吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. The justification of tragedies like that is an inevitable result of a seemingly infinite desire to be forgiven shared by nearly all humans.
lines.zh: : 当然不能。为那样的悲剧开脱，几乎是所有人类共有的、看似无限的「想要被原谅」的欲望所导致的必然结果。

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, it is.
lines.zh: : 是啊……是啊，没错。

lines.en: : What is it you want to be forgiven for, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你想被原谅的是什么呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : Everything, I guess.
lines.zh: : 一切吧，大概。

lines.en: : I just don’t want to put in the work required to actually {i}be{/i} forgiven.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想付出真正「取得」原谅所需要的努力。

lines.en: : And you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : Everything, I guess.
lines.zh: : 一切吧，大概。

lines.en: : I’d just rather hide from all of it because it’s exhausting even confronting things you don’t like looking back on.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿躲开这一切，因为光是直面那些不愿回望的事就已经让人筋疲力尽了。

lines.en: : Does it make you feel any less alone knowing you’re not the only one going through that?
lines.zh: : 知道不只是你一个人在经历这些，会让你觉得不那么孤单吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不会。

lines.en: : But I like being alone.
lines.zh: : 可我喜欢孤单。

lines.en: : So do I.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten24
: But...you spend virtually all of your time with other people. I barely ever even get to see you.
lines.zh: : 可是……你几乎所有时间都和别人在一起。我几乎都见不到你。

lines.en: : Being with other people is easier.
lines.zh: : 和别人在一起更容易。

lines.en: : When you’re alone, it’s a lot harder to ignore the parts of yourself you want forgiveness for.
lines.zh: : 独处的时候，你很难忽略自己身上那些想要被原谅的部分。

lines.en: : I think this is where our paths start to change directions.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们的路就是在这里开始分岔的。

lines.en: : When I’m alone, I can focus on whatever I want.
lines.zh: : 我独处的时候，可以专注于任何我想专注的事。

lines.en: : I can build things. Or read. Or watch baseball.
lines.zh: : 我可以做东西。或者看书。或者看棒球。

lines.en: : Or I guess text you now that I finally have your phone number.
lines.zh: : 或者，现在我终于有你的号码了，大概可以给你发短信。

lines.en: : But when I’m with anyone else, it’s like I’m constantly being reminded of everything I hate about this world.
lines.zh: : 可只要和别人在一起，我就仿佛被不断提醒着这世上我讨厌的一切。

lines.en: : And I understand that it’s irrational to live this way and that it will greatly increase the amount of stress I have and lead me to an early grave...
lines.zh: : 我也明白，这样活着并不理性，而且会大幅增加我的压力、让我早早进坟墓……

lines.en: : But there are some things that you can’t change. Or things you wouldn’t want to change.
lines.zh: : 可有些事是你改变不了的。或者你不想改变的。

lines.en: : Like...you, for example.
lines.zh: : 比如……你。

lines.en: : You’re just as fucked up as I am on the inside, but I’d hate for you to be anyone other than who you are.
lines.zh: : 你内心和我一样一团糟，可我讨厌你变成不是你的任何人。

lines.en: : Or who you think I am. You barely know me, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 或者是你以为的我。说到底，你根本不了解我。

lines.en: : I don’t need to know your story to know who you are.
lines.zh: : 我不需要知道你的故事，也能知道你是谁。

lines.en: : So long as you can understand where I’m coming from and I can understand where {i}you’re{/i} coming from, we can be completely different from one another but still exactly the same.
lines.zh: : 只要你能理解我的来处、我能理解{i}你{/i}的来处，我们就可以完全不同，却又完全相同。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten25
: Uhh....Wait. That sounded better in my head.
lines.zh: : 呃……等等。这话在脑子里听着更好。

lines.en: : It's a little too contradictory to put it that way.
lines.zh: : 这么说有点太自相矛盾了。

lines.en: : But...you understand...right?
lines.zh: : 可是……你明白的……对吧？

lines.en: : That...we don’t need to know everything about each other.
lines.zh: : 就是……我们不必知道彼此的一切。

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : But that will never mean we won’t {i}want{/i} to know.
lines.zh: : 可那也永远不意味着我们不会「{i}想{/i}」知道。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Umm...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sensei？

lines.en: : Is it...
: Is it wrong for me to hope that Yuki and Yumi never patch things up with one another?
lines.zh: : 我希望 Yuki 和 Yumi 永远不要和好，这是错的吗？

lines.en: : I mean...it’s not really your place to get involved.
lines.zh: : 我是说……这本来也轮不到你插手。

lines.en: : Are you afraid of losing Yuki or something?
lines.zh: : 你是怕失去 Yuki 什么的吗？

lines.en: : No. It’s nothing like that.
lines.zh: : 不是。不是那么回事。

lines.en: : I just think I’d have a little more faith in myself if I got to watch others fail as well.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，如果能看着别人也失败，我大概会对自己多一点信心。

lines.en: : There’s something incredibly vindicating about watching others struggle while you’re struggling yourself.
lines.zh: : 看着别人和自己一样挣扎，有种莫名的痛快。

lines.en: : It’s like turning off all of the lights and letting your eyes adjust.
lines.zh: : 就像关掉所有的灯，让眼睛慢慢适应。

lines.en: : If you fill your world with sadness, you’ll get used to it and get better at accepting it.
lines.zh: : 如果你让自己的世界充满悲伤，你就会习惯它，也会更擅长接受它。

lines.en: : If everything is depressing to begin with, you can manage to find joy in even minor tragedies because, by comparison, they really aren’t as bad as they could be.
lines.zh: : 如果一切从一开始就令人沮丧，你甚至能在微小的悲剧里找到快乐，因为相比之下，它们真的没那么糟。

lines.en: : I guess I just want more people to turn the lights off.
lines.zh: : 我想我只是希望有更多人把灯关掉。

lines.en: : And for me-
lines.zh: : 而对我来说——

lines.en: : It’s like everyone is walking into your room and turning them on.
lines.zh: : 就像每个人都走进你的房间，把灯打开。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten26
scene bathhouseten27
: Shouldn’t say what I was about to say yet.
lines.zh: : 我还没该说出我刚要说的那句话。

lines.en: : It’s too soon.
lines.zh: : 太早了。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten28
: When the[school] year ends...do you want to go somewhere with me?
lines.zh: : 等[school]年结束……你愿意和我去某个地方吗？

lines.en: : Where did you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 你想去哪儿？

lines.en: : Somewhere far away. Like...maybe America or something?
lines.zh: : 很远的地方。比如……也许是美国什么的？

lines.en: : We’re not allowed to leave Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 我们不许离开 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: : Then...an amusement park?
lines.zh: : 那……游乐园？

lines.en: : What is it with you and amusement parks all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然对游乐园这么执着？

lines.en: : It could be anywhere.
lines.zh: : 哪里都行。

lines.en: : But...I want to be with you.
lines.zh: : 但……我想和你在一起。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Why...not?
lines.zh: : 为什么……不？

lines.en: : I’m not sure how I feel about being with a girl who can look at me while I’m naked and not actually do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 我不确定自己怎么看待一个能看着我赤身裸体、却什么也不做的女孩。

lines.en: : But my hands are all cold and callused.
lines.zh: : 可我的手又冷又粗糙。

lines.en: : Still better than no hands at all.
lines.zh: : 总比没有手好。

lines.en: scene bathhouseten29
: Okay...that’s enough bathside talk for now.
lines.zh: : 好了……今天在池边的话就说到这儿吧。

lines.en: : I’m gonna go back to watching the game. But you’re free to take as long as you want in here.
lines.zh: : 我要回去看比赛了。不过你想在这儿待多久都行。

lines.en: : Also, if you hang around for a few more hours, you might get to see Uta’s boobs through the hole in the fence.
lines.zh: : 另外，如果你再多待几个小时，说不定能透过围栏上的洞看到 Uta 的奶子。

lines.en: : There’s a hole in the fence? Where?
lines.zh: : 围栏上有个洞？在哪儿？

lines.en: : {i}It’s a mystery.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这是个谜。{/i}

lines.en: : Io, you can’t just tell me something like that exists and then not help me.
lines.zh: : Io，你不能告诉我存在那种东西，却不帮我。

lines.en: : I’ll show you if you promise to run away with me one day.
lines.zh: : 如果你答应有一天和我私奔，我就带你看。

lines.en: : What kind of trade is that?
lines.zh: : 这算什么交易？

lines.en: : One where we both get something we want very badly.
lines.zh: : 我们各自都得到自己非常想要的东西的交易。

lines.en: : Ugh...
: I’ll just find it myself.
lines.zh: : 我自己找就是了。

lines.en: : And I’ll keep slowly poisoning myself with unattainable desires.
lines.zh: : 那我就继续用无法实现的欲望慢慢毒害自己。

lines.en: : Enjoy your bath, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 好好泡澡吧，Sensei。

lines.en: scene black
Io leaves and I suddenly feel a lot more alone than I thought I would.
lines.zh: Io 离开了，我突然觉得自己比想象中要孤单得多。

lines.en: Even the sound of the water is barely audible while I’m not moving around.
lines.zh: 我不动的时候，连水声都几乎听不见。

lines.en: And since no one seems to be on the other side of the bath right now, I can’t even steal away the opposing share of ambiance.
lines.zh: 而现在池子另一边似乎也没有人，我连对面那一份氛围都偷不来。

lines.en: I just soak.
lines.zh: 我只是泡着。

lines.en: In chemicals and uncertainty, I soak and wonder what it is that made Io the way she is.
lines.zh: 泡在化学物质和不确定里，我一边泡一边想，究竟是什么让 Io 成了现在这样。

lines.en: If it was anything at all.
lines.zh: 如果真有什么的话。

$ bathhouse10 = True
{i}Io’s affection has increased to [io_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!{/i}
